description: Agent GovCon: submit an award notice or contract award with the solicitation it closes, the winning price record and the eligibility record: the award with its contract number, the solicitation number it closes, the awardee and its unique entity identifier, the currency, the awarded amount, the first and last day of the period of performance and each term or clause it carries; the solicitation with its number, the period of performance it states and each term or clause it states; the price record with its offeror, currency and total; the eligibility record with the legal business name and unique entity identifier. The signed report gives the award and the solicitation, the awarded amount read against the winning price, the period of performance read against the solicitation’s at both ends, the awardee read against the eligibility record by name and identifier, and each award term read against the solicitation’s terms, and counts them, and names a divergent award: an awarded amount unlike the winning price record or in another currency, a period of performance unlike the solicitation’s, an awardee unlike the eligibility record, and a term carried into the award that the solicitation never stated; then another solicitation number and a price record for another offeror, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No winning price, no awarded amount, a period stated at only one end, no awardee on either record, or no terms on the solicitation leaves those points unverified. Amounts compare to the cent in one currency, the awardee as a party without case, punctuation or a legal suffix, and terms by the FAR or DFARS clause number they carry or by their words. This reads a procurement contract award: wever_grant-award-check reads a grant award or agreement against the application under assistance terms, while the award check reads the contract award against the solicitation it closes. Verdict govcon_award_divergent, govcon_award_partial, govcon_award_unverified or govcon_award_consistent. POST /api/govcon-award-check. Reads the government contracting records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between contracting documents only: it never submits a bid or proposal, never registers or certifies a vendor in any government system, never contacts an agency and never decides eligibility or award, which stay with the contracting agency, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent GovCon reads government contracting records across the procurement lifecycle for consistency between the documents and the terms they answer to: a solicitation, a vendor’s eligibility record, a proposal or bid, a price proposal or pricing volume, an award notice, a contract modification, a deliverable or progress report and an invoice or payment voucher, each against its own sections and the notice it follows, the solicitation’s set-aside, eligibility, submission and pricing terms, the winning price and eligibility record, the base award and prior modifications, the deliverable schedule, or the payment terms and acceptance record it should agree with. The family reads procurement, the government buying goods and services under contract terms, and reads the records against each other. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-govcon-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-govcon/.
